correctness.rationale: The quadratic-observable generator closes in the stated convention: the two unit-rate end jumps give half damping on an end index and a unit source at site 1; two number-projector dephasers contribute gamma to each off-diagonal datum. For the homogeneous stationary covariance the Hilbert–Schmidt pairing forces the end rows to vanish, and the connected tridiagonal commutator successively forces the interior rows to vanish. A bounded exact symbolic reconstruction formed real and imaginary upper-triangular equations from -i[h,C]-RC-CR+S-g(C-diag C), solved the 16-variable system and the nearest-neighbour subsystem, and verified their C44 rational functions and the positive factored difference. Expanding N_g D-N D_g confirmed degree 12, strictly negative coefficients in t for q4 through q12, coefficient-by-coefficient agreement for q0 through q3 and their opposite endpoint signs on the four specified disjoint rational brackets. Descartes then gives the ordered t-roots and the unique simple positive g-root exactly when t exceeds t_c; sqrt(t_c)=0.303236990165122 to the stated precision. The singular corner g=t=0 of the closure must be read as extension along t=0 (the retained equations give 2/5); there is no joint continuity because the limit along g=0 is zero. This does not affect the stated zero-tilt convention or the strict nonzero-tilt claim. The independent certificate rederived the stationary algebra and sign test; it did not rerun the uploaded reproduction or its Fock-space spot checks.
